source: Outlook review of ben@sandpiperre.com (read-only), 2026-10-11 → 2026-11-02. Automated run; no LOI search. Comps include the KBC Puget Sound IOS Q4 2026 survey.

status: Price cut to $3.9M by signed amendment 10/17 (from $4.0M; cash at closing $3.88M, $20K EM unchanged). Second amendment fully signed 10/29 moves the inspection deadline to 11/4 and closing to 11/11.

Ben owes: PSA assignment to SP Brighton IOS LLC (Pat says on 11/2 the 10/29 amendment doesn't cover it; lender and title need it); tenant estoppel + SNDA with SP Brighton IOS LLC as landlord; signed RIO PMA (Chad sent the Adobe Sign 10/29); loan-doc legal comments (FIB outside date 11/6); Cost Sharing Agreement comments; equipment schedule re-signed to SP Brighton IOS LLC.

Tenant: estoppel was due 10/28 and is held up by Zero Carbon asking for its $100K LOC back. Ben met David Church (Zero Carbon) 10/29 and asked for a call on renewal plans past the Feb 2028 expiry, funding/runway and milestones.

Capital/debt: CentrePoint (Alan Bruno) JV. Polsinelli sent a revised CPP-SPC Holdco JVA 10/30. Essex (Cooper Williams): no legal opinion or SPE covenants; Cooper to lock the rate. Open: FIB can't use $95K of the $160K capex holdback for the interest reserve; Fund I 25% guaranty burn-off.

Done: Phase I reliance letter from True North 11/2 (FIB, CentrePoint, SP Brighton). True North also flagged a past-due $3,600 Phase I invoice 11/2. Title chain now includes Polsinelli and CentrePoint (10/30).
Risks: estoppel/LOC dispute with 2 days left in DD; tenant credit and renewal; water district restriction + unreleased 2018 O&G lease.

PSA executed: FNF (escrow FBDO-2611368) confirmed receipt of the executed contract 10/21. Ben confirmed all seller DD deliveries in hand as of 10/27; the 60-day investigation runs from delivery, so roughly 12/26 (inferred). Ben's target close is 01/27 (per the Ryan tax request).

Environmental is the gating item: Ben is 'pencils down' on other DD until comfortable (10/27). Env kickoff 10/26 with GeoEngineers (Garrett Leque) + True North (Chris Valcheff): PCE source at the SW machine shop, vinyl chloride remains, site is in the VCP, ~$430K of the $631K remediation budget left, NFA targeted ~May 2028. GeoEngineers uploaded files to Box 10/27. Mackenzie site plan put on hold 10/27.
Title/survey: objections due 10 days after title + survey are received (PSA §2.1). Title commitment from FNF 10/29. Ben plans to start the survey ~11/4–11/7. No zoning report yet.
Leasing: NAI (Taylor Hudson) flyer live at $0.42/SF (Ben OK'd 10/26). Sunbelt tour 11/12 at 9:00am. Leads: Squan, Barnhart, Domino's (via Greg Millerd, C&W).

Ben owes: reply to CBRE (Steve Brunette) on MVP signing a King County Sheriff hold-harmless for training on site (10/30); GC budget + scope to CCIG for builder's risk quote. Burke (Jaden McQuivey) is handling the legal calendar.
CONSTRUCTION. Owner: Verona IOS LLC. GC: TJK ($907,220; substantial completion 12/2). Property manager/accounting: HighPoint (Edan Avital, Michelle Goss, Karen Mijangos).
TJK Draw #1 $290,691.25: Ben said it looked good 10/20; HighPoint (Karen) asked 10/26 for his site-visit confirmation so it can be paid.

Change order ~$32K (window replacement after vandalism, First Student fencing, well replacement, security cameras) circulated to partners 10/22. Ben returned it to TJK (Sandy Frankland) 10/28 (signed, inferred).
First Student (1 ac north parcel): Oakbrook (Simon Faust) sent completed vendor/payment forms to YardFlow (Rafi) 10/29. First Student local contact: Alissa Matusiewicz.

Other: RBN (Mitch) sent a preliminary OPX calc 10/28 (site SF may change with land leasing). DD vendor invoices approved; HighPoint was waiting on direction for one item (10/20). Adams easement comments still open.
Signed purchase LOI at $14.5M (buyer response signed 10/30) plus a signed lease LOI: a 7-year lease to Carvana (IE).
Ben is drafting the PSA and aims to sign it by about 11/11–11/13 (inferred from 'mid next week to Friday' on 11/2), targeting close the week of Jan 11.
Capital: CentrePoint pursuit meeting 11/3. Aasif is interested in the full equity stack if CPP passes. Debt: Essex (Cooper Williams) got the model and pursuit memo 11/2.
Off-market United Site Services yard via Dave Faris (SRS). 14,700 SF building (1978) on 1.92 ac. USS leaves March 2027 and pays ~$7/SF, so it's priced as vacant. Seller pays no fee.
Ben sent an LOI 10/20. Seller countered at $2,205,000 (signed 10/26). Ben's max is $1.7M (10/30), and Faris took $1.7M to the seller 11/2. Awaiting response.
Sister site 2218 Cedardale Rd, Mount Vernon WA (2.55 ac) already has a $2.5M offer vs Ben's $2M; not pursuing (inferred).

Off-market via Donald Flynn (Elegran) 10/29. 15-door truck terminal + warehouse (1977, 14–16' clear), zoned I-A. Leased through 8/2027 at ~$15,400/mo NNN with no options; the tenant says it will leave. Seller says re-lease is $20K+/mo. $4M guidance.
Same owner, one block SW: 5201 N Jackson St + 3700 E 53rd Ave, ~4.07 ac unpaved yard, $3M guidance. Can trade together or separately. Seller says both passed a Phase I last year.
Ben is reviewing and setting a call with Don (Don offered 9:30am, 10/30).
